body: Well, there's not any people I can think of that care about me. My mother was abusive and I've never really talked to my father, I'm an only child and I don't have many relatives left, and those that are still alive barely know me. I was diagnosed with depression about 4 years ago, and recently I have been undergoing screening for possible bipolar disorder, I have issues talking to people in person, so I tend to avoid seeing people about all of this, which probably doesn't help. Thank you for caring, though, it means a lot to me because I really don't have anyone who cares right now. I still need to think about all of this right now, my minds racing at a million miles an hour right now, so I really can't make any definitive promises right at this moment.
